mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC path whose 480 log prices are well explained by one linear time trend represents sustained price discovery rather than endpoint luck. When the fitted slope, full block, and final two hours agree, follow that direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of OLS slope, completed eight-hour return, and final-two-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTFR uses all 480 price levels and coefficient of determination against fixed time. Path efficiency uses total distance, momentum uses endpoints, autocorrelation uses returns, and duration candidates use running extrema. HVTFR uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, fitted outcomes, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail restricts activation to volatile blocks while high R-squared requires the volatility to organize around a persistent directional trend
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC 480-point trend-fit onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.trend_fit: OLS of log(close_i) on fixed integer time i=0..479 with intercept
features.trend_slope: finite strict nonzero OLS time coefficient
features.r_squared: 1-SSE/SST; SST strict positive and result finite in [0,1]
features.trend_fit_rank: strict-prior midrank of r_squared over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: slope, block return, and late return have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
